text:
mike_sales: Starting a thread for NimbusWorks co-sell POC asks. They want a 2-week private-tenant trial, sample SSQ answers, SSO + SCIM onboarding, and a conservative reserved pricing estimate for a small dedicated pool.

nora_se: NimbusWorks legal attached a 40-page SSQ and a data residency requirement (eu-central). They asked if pilot can use redwood-managed KMS and whether BYOK/HSM is supported for production.

sara_privsec: I'll take the SSQ. For pilot we can offer redwood-managed KMS with key export disabled. For prod we support BYOK + HSM integrations; need to include an attestation for key handling. Also they asked for a redacted SOC2 and an incident response summary.

jules_ops: Ops can spin a constrained private tenant for 14 days if they sign a pilot amendment and prepay a baseline charge. We'll limit CPU/GPU and network egress; add teardown automation. Need their peering CIDR ranges and preferred peering method (VPC peering or PrivateLink).

alan_eng: Perf request from Nimbus: steady 40 rps at 350 tokens, p50 <0.17s/token. With KV cache and batching that should be doable on a small reserved pool. Ballpark reserved cost: $20k-$30k/mo depending on region and commitment. Trial add-on: $2.5k prepaid for the 2-week tenant.

mike_sales: Good. Nimbus wants the trial before procurement signs off on longer deals. Can we provide templates for SAML metadata and SCIM endpoints? They use Okta.

auth-bot: SAML metadata sample:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://console.redwood.example/saml">
  <!-- ACS: https://console.redwood.example/saml/acs -->
  <!-- x509cert here -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```
SCIM notes: POST /scim/v2/Users Authorization: Bearer <token>. Patch supported for group sync.

sara_privsec: I'll bundle SOC2 redacted, an incident response one-pager, and our data deletion SLA (48h for ephemeral logs; metrics retention configurable). Ask Nimbus if they need SIEM forwarding (Splunk/Datadog).

jules_ops: Ops action items: collect Nimbus CIDRs, provision trial tenant after prepay, publish teardown schedule. Engineering action: provide perf sim runbook and expected instance counts.

alan_eng: I'll prepare the perf sim and a short runbook: load phases, KV warmup, expected autoscale curve. Will post numbers tomorrow.

mike_sales: Nora, please get Okta metadata and confirm SCIM provisioning. Also confirm whether Nimbus wants audit logs exported to their SIEM during the trial.

nora_se: Sending Okta metadata by EOD; SCIM = yes. They prefer logs to be pushed to their Splunk instance for the trial.

sara_privsec: Splunk forwarding ok for trial, but we'll redact sensitive tokens. Need their Splunk HEC endpoint and ingestion token.

mike_sales: Final Q: can ops allow trial tenants to test BYOK flows (with ephemeral keys) or is that prod-only?

jules_ops: BYOK for trial is not allowed (security constraints). We can demo the BYOK onboarding flow with screenshots and run a simulated key rotation. Production-only for actual HSM-backed keys.

mike_sales: Thanks all. Summarizing actions: 1) Sara = SSQ pack + SOC2 + IR one-pager, 2) Jules = trial tenant runbook + prepay instructions, 3) Alan = perf sim + sizing, 4) Nora = Okta metadata + Splunk HEC info. I'll follow up with Nimbus and share pilot amendment.

nora_se: On it. Scheduling a 45-min enablement session next Tue to walk SAML/SCIM and telemetry.

mike_sales: Great, closing thread for now. Will post pilot amendment when ready. :rocket:
